$doc:tile@1.name: tile

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: its tint

comment: what the tile is for, above the definition

values.name: n
comment: how many times it was pressed

core:press@1.name: press
core:press@1.about: Anything clickable and focusable: a button, a tab, an option among others, an on/off toggle or switch, an answer row with a tick (check) or a dot (radio), or its content itself, such as a card (plain).

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: accessible name when the content has no text

inputs.name: emphasis
inputs.about: how much it stands out: low for one of a row of quiet buttons, high for the one to press

inputs.name: mark
inputs.about: an answer row's letter (A, B, C), shown in its tick or dot until it is chosen

outs.name: enter
outs.about: the pointer moved onto it, or it took focus

outs.name: leave
outs.about: the pointer left it, or it lost focus

core:text@1.name: text
core:text@1.about: A styled run of inline Markdown with inline maths.

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: its colour; none: the colour around it (a press's, a list's)

inputs.name: lines
inputs.about: height kept for this many lines, so a shorter text moves nothing below it

inputs.name: clip
inputs.about: cut it at lines= lines, with an ellipsis

inputs.name: literal
inputs.about: show the value as it is, not read as inline Markdown

inputs.name: caps
inputs.about: in spaced capitals: a caption or a label over a column

inputs.name: align
inputs.about: how children sit across it; a child's self= overrides

inputs.name: justify
inputs.about: where the children sit down it, when it is taller than they are

inputs.name: pad
inputs.about: inner padding

inputs.name: padx
inputs.about: padding at the left and right, in place of pad there

inputs.name: pady
inputs.about: padding at the top and bottom, in place of pad there

inputs.name: gap
inputs.about: space between children

inputs.name: width
inputs.about: fit: as wide as its widest child; fill: the whole row

inputs.name: minwidth
inputs.about: never narrower than this; with scroll=x, what doesn't fit scrolls sideways

inputs.name: scroll
inputs.about: x: scrolls sideways when narrower than its content

inputs.name: fill
inputs.about: background

inputs.name: tint
inputs.about: a wash of this colour behind it: a state, not a surface

inputs.name: stroke
inputs.about: border

inputs.name: line
inputs.about: the border's line

inputs.name: edge
inputs.about: which sides the border is drawn on

inputs.name: weight
inputs.about: the border's width

inputs.name: radius
inputs.about: corner radius

inputs.name: dim
inputs.about: faded back, while something else is in focus

inputs.name: blur
inputs.about: blurred past reading, until it is revealed

outs.name: click
outs.about: a press on its background, not on a child (pointer only)

outs.name: enter
outs.about: the pointer moved onto it (pointer only: a container takes no focus)

kit:callout@1.name: callout
kit:callout@1.about: A note set off from the text in its tone: a soft wash and a border all round, the icon and title in the tone over the message.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: a first line, in the tone, beside the icon; none for a message alone

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: info, ok, warn, bad or accent

inputs.name: icon
inputs.about: the symbol; none for the tone's own (info, check, alert, lightbulb)

values.name: glyph
values.body: if(t == ok, check, if(t == warn or t == bad, alert, if(t == accent, lightbulb, info)))

local:kit:callout@1:glyph#0.name: glyph
local:kit:callout@1:glyph#0.src: if(t == ok, check, if(t == warn or t == bad, alert, if(t == accent, lightbulb, info)))

inputs.name: name

inputs.name: tone

inputs.name: label

kit:rows@1.name: rows
kit:rows@1.about: A list of things, one a row: a state or an icon, a title with a badge, a note under it and a detail on the right. Checks, services, files, people, links.

inputs.name: items
inputs.about: the rows; title and note are inline Markdown, so a title can be a link

md.expr: join(map(items, e => "- **" + e.title + "**" + if(e.state != none, " (" + e.state + ")", "") + if(e.badge != "", " `" + e.badge + "`", "") + if(e.note != "", ": " + e.note, "") + if(e.meta != "", " — " + e.meta, "")), "\n")

kit:pill@1.name: pill
kit:pill@1.about: A short label on a pill in a tone, with an optional icon: a state, a version, a platform, a change.

kit:marker@1.name: marker
kit:marker@1.about: A round marker: an icon, a number or nothing, washed in its tone and outlined, or filled with it, or quiet.

inputs.name: number

inputs.name: solid

inputs.name: quiet
inputs.about: no wash, a line for an outline, the number muted: a step still to come

inputs.name: outline
inputs.about: a line round it in its tone

kit:stats@1.name: stats
kit:stats@1.about: Key numbers in tiles: a label, the number large, how it changed, and a sparkline of its trend.

inputs.name: items
inputs.about: the tiles, in order; change is signed (+12%, -3); trend draws a sparkline

values.name: moved
values.body: if(s.tone != none, s.tone, if(startswith(s.change, "+"), ok, if(startswith(s.change, "-") or startswith(s.change, "−"), bad, muted)))

values.name: arrow
values.body: if(startswith(s.change, "+"), up, if(startswith(s.change, "-") or startswith(s.change, "−"), down, none))

values.name: hi
values.body: max(fold(xs, at(xs, 0, 0), (a, v) => max(a, v)), lo(xs) + 0.000001)

md.expr: join(map(items, s => "- **" + s.label + "**: " + s.value + if(s.change != "", " (" + s.change + ")", "") + if(s.note != "", " — " + s.note, "")), "\n")

local:kit:stats@1:moved#0.name: moved
local:kit:stats@1:moved#0.src: if(s.tone != none, s.tone, if(startswith(s.change, "+"), ok, if(startswith(s.change, "-") or startswith(s.change, "−"), bad, muted)))

local:kit:stats@1:arrow#0.name: arrow
local:kit:stats@1:arrow#0.src: if(startswith(s.change, "+"), up, if(startswith(s.change, "-") or startswith(s.change, "−"), down, none))

local:kit:stats@1:hi#0.name: hi
local:kit:stats@1:hi#0.src: max(fold(xs, at(xs, 0, 0), (a, v) => max(a, v)), lo(xs) + 0.000001)

core:canvas@1.name: canvas
core:canvas@1.about: A 2D coordinate space with layers drawn in the order written. Lines, rectangles and curves are paths.

inputs.name: z
inputs.about: 3D only

inputs.name: aspect
inputs.about: width over height; 0 means from the ranges

inputs.name: size
inputs.about: its width

inputs.name: height
inputs.about: a fixed height, so it fills a stage of that height; none: from the aspect

inputs.name: dims
inputs.about: 3 needs gfx@1

inputs.name: view
inputs.about: 3D camera: azimuth and elevation in degrees

kit:statetone#0.name: statetone
kit:statetone#0.src: if(s == done or s == pass, ok, if(s == fail or s == blocked, bad, if(s == warn, warn, if(s == running, info, if(s == active, accent, muted)))))

kit:stateicon#0.name: stateicon
kit:stateicon#0.src: if(s == done or s == pass, check, if(s == fail, cross, if(s == warn or s == blocked, alert, if(s == active or s == running, play, if(s == skipped, minus, if(s == todo, circle, none))))))
